author: PAULGA

inputs.purpose: the PAULGA mark as supplied by the product's owner

method.kind: code-generated render of the owner's mark
method.transform: Draw the mark's rectangles and ellipses at 4096 px with the black field replaced by the nightly background, clip to the rounded tile (rx 112 of 512), scale down with Lanczos to each size; Mac sizes pad the tile to 824/1024. PNG frames packed into ICO and ICNS. No crescent, letter or badge.

validation: Dimensions and ICO frame sizes checked by the tests in apps/photocraft/src/app_icon.rs. The ICNS was written by Pillow, not iconutil; it has not been opened in Finder, and no native Explorer, Finder or app-package check has been run.
